sloka: ओषधिं नावगच्छामि तामहं हरिपुङ्गव ।तदिदं शिखरं कृत्स्नं गिरेस्तस्याहृतं मया ।। ६.१०२.३२ ।।
transliteration: oṣadhiṁ nāvagacchāmi tāmahaṁ haripuṅgava ।tadidaṁ śikharaṁ kṛtsnaṁ girestasyāhṛtaṁ mayā ।। 6.102.32 ।।

translations.english: 'If I go without taking Visalakarani, through the passage of time huge mistakes will happen and perplexity will arise'.
